//: THE FULL SWEEP — everything the repo can type-check in one pass.
`tsconfig.json` is what `next build` reads, so it describes the DEPLOYED app
and leaves out tests, verify scripts and `mobile/` (see its own note). That
is right for the build and useless as a pre-push gate: two scripts and two
tests reached Vercel on 2026-09-08 having never been type-checked by
anything, and each failed the build in turn.
This puts them back. `npm run typecheck` runs it, and it is the command to
trust before pushing — NOT `npx tsc --noEmit`, which now reads the build
config and will tell you everything is fine.
⚠ `mobile` STAYS OUT, and that is not an oversight. Its `@/` resolves to
`mobile/*` under `mobile/tsconfig.json`; pulled in here every one of those
imports reports TS2307. The phone has its own check:
`cd mobile && npx tsc --noEmit`. Files here may still IMPORT from mobile —
exclusion governs which files are program roots, not module resolution.
(`Property 'get' does not exist on type 'FormData'`). They are local only —
Vercel compiles that route cleanly. See the dev-deploy memory.
